gaps.sentence: Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.

gaps.sentence: The novel is a ___ (FICTION) account of real events.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.
'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
